_comment: Class Progression (design doc v3): each class here gets a hard FORK at 'fork_level' into two lanes; classes absent from this file simply level along their base tables. Each lane: 'name' + 'archetype' (the name shown from capstone level on), 'blurb' (shown on the choice card), 'offsets' (permanent adds to the class table: hit = to-hit AND damage, ac = armor class, sp = spell points, detect = trap/secret %), 'passive' (always-on, from the passive list below), 'verb' (the signature action gained at its 'level'), 'capstone' (gained at its 'level'; numbers tunable), 'refinement' (upgrades the verb at its 'level'), and 'rite' (the Level 20 Rite, see below). PASSIVES: weapon_focus (+dmg with a chosen weapon category — the player picks which at the fork), braced_stance (-'reduce' damage taken per hit while a shield is worn), vital_strike, keen_senses, prepared_mind (the Wizard lane's spellbook: only prepared spells are castable; slots = 'slots_base' + max spell level; re-pick freely at each rest), overchannel (the Sorcerer lane: every cast costs 'discount' less SP, floor 1; knows only 'known_per_level' spells per spell level, picked on unlock), blessed_hands (+'heal' HP on every heal spell), sacred_weapon (+'dmg' divine damage on weapon hits). VERBS: rampage, guardians_stand, assassinate, vanish, arcane_insight (once per battle, your action: choose +'hit' to-hit, +'dc' save DC, or +'dmg' spell damage for the rest of the fight), overcast (toggle: pay 'cost_mult'x SP to cast a spell one level higher — +'extra_dice' damage/healing, +'dc_bonus' DC), mercy (free reaction: an ally cut to 0 HP immediately rises with 'dice' + WIS HP), zealous_strike (toggle: each landed melee hit spends 'cost' SP for +'dice' divine damage and 'heal' self-healing). CAPSTONES: rage, bulwark, lethality, set_trap, archmage (once per rest: cast ANY spellbook spell, prepared or not, for ALL remaining SP), twin_surge (once per rest: a spell resolves twice, then you are Exhausted a round), miracle (once per rest, ALL remaining SP, 'min_sp' minimum: the living are fully healed, the fallen rise at half), divine_inspiration (ALL remaining SP, 'min_sp' minimum: +'hit'/+'dmg'/+'ac' for 'rounds' rounds). REFINEMENTS: rampage_crits, stand_half_cost, assassinate_low_hp, vanish_free, insight_double (Arcane Insight grants TWO bonus types), overcast_cheap (Overcast costs 1.5x, rounded up), mercy_cures (Mercy also cures one condition), zealous_immunity (a Zealous Strike grants immunity to conditions until your next turn). TESTING TIP: the Playtest Bench (P) banks XP and bumps playstyle counters — the fastest road to any milestone. | NEW (2026-08-29): passives sundered_calm/granite_skin/warding_presence (a passive may carry a 'name' — weapon_focus wears 'Edge Eternal' for the Spellblade); verbs runic_riposte, ward_surge, unyielding, shared_fortitude; capstones whirling_verse, mirror_ward, mountains_heart, deep_roots; refinements riposte_allies, ward_surge_allies, unyielding_allies, fortitude_two; rite verbs crescendo, unbroken_chord, bedrock, hearthfire; counters riposteKills, wardDeflects, unyieldingSaves, alliesFortified. | RANGER (2026-08-29): passives ambidexterity/snap_shot; verbs hunters_surge/volley; capstones storm_of_blades/rain_of_arrows; refinements offhand_free/hawk_on_the_move; rite verbs pack_instinct/true_shot; counters surgeKills/volleyKills. | LANE GROWTH (designer session 2026-09-02): a lane may carry a "growth" block {levels, options} — the hero picks ONE option at each level listed, and every list deliberately holds MORE options than picks so two heroes of the same lane end up different (the designer's goal: "your level 20 stoneshaper could be super different than a previous one"). Effect fields, all optional: brace_vs ('spell'|'trap') · brace_bonus N · brace_no_shield · brace_allies (Braced Stance) · refuse <conditionId> (Bulwark: the mountain simply cannot get it) · aura_ac/aura_reduce/aura_saves N, aura_party, aura_refuse <conditionId> (Warding Presence) · vital_when ('poisoned'|'wounded'|'held'|'frightened'|'alone'|'bigger') (Vital Strike triggers) · skill N, find_range N, find_sure (passive detection within reach never rolls — it simply finds), search_turns N, disarm_safe, chest_safe (the rogue's craft) · saves N (anyone). ALL names, blurbs and numbers are PROPOSALS — rewrite freely. Ranger lanes deliberately have no growth: Favored Enemy already is one. TEXT FIELDS (2026-09-04, moved out of the engine so they are yours): every passive has a 'blurb' shown on the crossroads card — write {field} to quote one of the passive's own numbers (e.g. '+{dmg} damage', '{name}: …'); every verb and capstone may carry 'how' (the 'how to use it' line on the milestone card); every rite has 'tracked_label' (the tally row on the character sheet) and 'tracked_deed' (the sentence fragment on the Rite's title step).
_xp_comment: XP CURVE (playtest proposal 2026-08-30, replaces the flat legacy 50 x level): XP to reach the NEXT level = base x growth^(level-1), rounded to the nearest 5. With 50/1.3: level 1->2 costs 50, 5->6 costs 145, 10->11 costs 530, 15->16 costs 1,955, 19->20 costs 5,600 - about 24,000 total to reach 20 (the old rule needed only 9,500, so a full-run party hit 20 on floor 13 and skipped the last third of the dungeon). Tune base/growth freely; delete the block to fall back to 50 x level.
_rite_comment: THE LEVEL 20 RITE (doc v3). 'sigil' lists the shared 8x8x8 vocabulary — every hero draws from the same pool. Per lane, 'rite' has: 'ability' (the unique capstone verb — engine knows 'whirlwind' and 'aegis'; name/numbers are CONTENT FLAGS, rename and retune freely), 'tracked' (which playstyle counter gates the title: rampageKills or standSaves), and 'tiers' — three entries, low to high: 'min' (counter needed; thresholds are proposals, doc says TBD pending playtesting) and 'title' (offered wording; the player may re-word it but keeps the tier). Tier 2 grants 'trinket' (an item id); tier 3 also records the lane's vignette-dungeon unlock (the dungeon itself is a later build).

sigil_art._comment: The visual sigil layers (generated by tools/genart.py from data/art_manifest.json — regenerate any piece there). Each vocabulary word above maps to a white-on-transparent image the engine TINTS with the color hex and composites (shape under, modifier over). A word with no entry here (or a missing file) simply falls back to words-only — nothing breaks. Dark colors automatically get a pale glow so they read on dark panels.

ability_boost._comment: THE LEVEL-10 ABILITY BOOST (designer ruling 2026-09-02): every class, every lane, gets +1 to ONE ability of the player's choice at each level listed. This is the ONLY way an ability rises after creation — no item in the game grants ability scores any more, so the race you picked keeps mattering. Add more levels to the list (e.g. [10, 20]) or raise 'amount' freely.

grant.name: Snares
grant._comment: SNARES (designer ruling 2026-09-03): granted with the lane at the fork, not held back to the capstone — a rogue should be laying snares long before 15. Aimed like a spell within "range"; placing ALWAYS works (the turn is the cost), and thief skill instead sets the save DC of the snare types that carry a rider. Damage is "dice" +"scale.dice" for every "scale.per_levels" levels above the fork.

wizard._comment: Doc v3 Wizard, magic v3 (2026-08-28): every wizard keeps a spellbook from level 1 (classes.json 'spellbook'); the fork decides what becomes of it. The Spellbook lane keeps studying and hunting scrolls (prepared_mind: 'slots_bonus' extra prepared slots). The Raw Gift sets the book aside: 'known_per_level' picks per spell level (from the catalog or the former book), plus one wild pick at each 'bonus_pick_levels'; every cast costs 'discount' less. spellblade._comment: Elven Spellblade (companion doc v1, 2026-08-29): Bladesong (offense) vs Wardsong (defense), a ±1 lean on hit/AC like the Warrior's fork. PASSIVES: weapon_focus wearing the name Edge Eternal (+1 damage with a chosen weapon type — the pick pops at the fork), sundered_calm (+'saves' on every save). VERBS: runic_riposte (a free retaliatory attack whenever a monster's melee blow lands on you; at 18 also when it lands on an ally beside you), ward_surge (a Y/N reaction BEFORE a monster's swing at you resolves: spend 'cost' SP for +'ac' AC and saves against that one attack; at 18 also for an ally beside you). CAPSTONES: whirling_verse (playtest revision v1.1: costs ALL remaining SP, 'min_sp' at least, and immediately ends your active Stance; 'rounds' rounds of one free extra strike per landed weapon hit — the all-in gamble), mirror_ward ('rounds' rounds: 'reflect' of every melee wound is thrown back at the attacker; you cannot move while it holds). Tracked: riposteKills / wardDeflects (surges that turned a hit into a miss + wounds reflected).

stoneshaper._comment: Dwarven Stoneshaper (companion doc v1, 2026-08-29): Bulwark (personal) vs Hearthstone (shared), trading AC against spell points like the Priest's fork. PASSIVES: granite_skin (−'reduce' damage from every un-elemental blow), warding_presence (+'saves' on every save for allies standing beside you). VERBS: unyielding (a blow that would drop you to 0 HP leaves you at 1 instead — UNCAPPED per the doc; at 18 also for an ally beside you), shared_fortitude ('cost' SP: one ally gains 'dice' + your CON of absorbed damage for the battle; at 18 two allies for the same cost). CAPSTONES: mountains_heart ('rounds' rounds: every wound halved, crits cannot land — while your hit/damage bonus is 0 and you cannot move), deep_roots (once per rest, ALL remaining SP, 'min_sp' minimum: every AC/save/resist buff on you is copied to the whole party for 'rounds' rounds). Tracked: unyieldingSaves / alliesFortified (allies fortified, buffed, or sheltered by Deep Roots). Monsters never crit in this engine — Mountain's Heart's crit immunity is recorded for the day they do.

lanes.blurb: Be the mountain. Harder to hurt, fewer spell points — and you simply refuse to fall.

verb.how: It happens on its own: any blow that would drop you to 0 HP leaves you at 1 instead. Poison and spellfire are not blows — mind them.

ranger._comment: Half-Elven Ranger (companion doc v1): Way of the Wolf (two blades) vs Way of the Hawk (the bow). The lean lives in the style PENALTIES, not the stat tables (doc's deliberate deviation): no 'offsets'. PASSIVES: ambidexterity (off-hand penalty 4 → 'penalty' 2; +'dmg' with one-handed melee weapons), snap_shot (point-blank penalty → 'point_blank' 0; +'dmg' with bows). VERBS: hunters_surge (a stance: while ON each attack action spends 'cost' SP so the off-hand matches the main hand blow for blow), volley (a bow kill grants a free shot at another foe in range — chains while kills and arrows last). CAPSTONES: storm_of_blades (ALL remaining SP, min 1: 'rounds' rounds of a free off-hand strike after every main-hand hit at no penalty, +'dmg' on every attack), rain_of_arrows ('rounds' rounds: every shot also strikes every foe within 'spread' squares of the target, one arrow per foe struck; you cannot move). REFINEMENTS: offhand_free (no off-hand penalty at all), hawk_on_the_move (steady bows shoot after moving). Tracked: surgeKills (kills during Hunter's Surge / Storm of Blades) / volleyKills. Titles: the 1e ladder Scout / Pathfinder / Ranger Lord, shared by both lanes.

summoner._comment: The Summoner (designer session 2026-09-05): Druid (animals → elementals, heal/cure/thorns) vs Shaman (spirits, enchant + offensive verses). BOTH lanes' real content is the 'summons' ladder: [{from, id, cost, two_from, choose?, name?}] — from character level 'from' the C menu offers the data/summons.json creature 'id' for 'cost' SP; from 'two_from' one call brings TWO (the designer's band rule: one for the first three levels of a band, two for the last two); 'choose' lists several creatures the caller picks between at each call (the four elementals), 'name' is how the ladder speaks of that band. The lane ladder REPLACES the class's pre-fork wisp ladder in classes.json. PASSIVES wild_call / spirit_call are the ladders' names — no numbers. VERB (10) and CAPSTONE (15) are the ladder's second and third bands, narrated; REFINEMENT twin_call (18) is the top band's two_from, narrated. RITE abilities carry 'summon' (the creature) and 'min_sp': once per battle, ALL remaining SP (min_sp at least) calls it. Tracked: summonKills (foes slain by a hero's summons). GROWTH (8/14/16) modifies every creature the hero calls: summon_ac / summon_dmg (flat, named in the math), summon_hp (a fraction more HP), summon_attacks (extra blows), summon_inflict {condition, rounds, dc} (a rider on every landed blow), summon_first (the creature acts BEFORE its master in the round), summon_immune [conditions], summon_revive (returns once a battle at half HP). Titles, trinkets and the Rite creatures are CONTENT FLAGS; every number is a proposal.
